points.form: 申す versus おっしゃる
points.teachingChoice: Own name and respected caller; irregular polite ending おっしゃいます.

points.form: おっしゃっていただけますか
points.teachingChoice: Ask for the missing time, then confirm it; no guess becomes a promise.

points.form: 承る and 申し伝える
points.teachingChoice: Taking a message and relaying it are separate from the colleague agreeing to a callback.

NEC classification of all お/ご prefixes as 丁寧語 is not adopted; Culture Agency five-way distinctions prevail.
